name: Khan Shaka
objectiveText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace . Khan Shaka's Head  ( 1 )   Magram Clan Centaur  ( Friendly )

comments.body: Found him in the back of the cave where you found the broken tears.  Once your inside follow the cave till it splits.  Here there are 2 ways to go, you must go straight behind the tent.  The way right leads to a dead end, but if you do go right you can jump down to the path that leads to the Khan.  The Khan has 2 level 36 body guards who agro with him.  I managed to get him and his two buddies to agro without the rest of the room.  The cave entrance is at loc 38, 90
his cords are 40,96

Soloed at lvl 36 Warrior. Not a prob at all. Just kill the guy, and loot, then your out. And for warriors: Use Intimidating Shout, it will fear the guard away, and you can kill him easy and loot:)

At first, killed a bunch of Gelkis around the outside camp and the lower area before going into the cave. The cave [b](where you previously collected Theradras' Tears)[/b] is huge, but stick to the right, as others have said. At first, I went left...but here's only a small camp there.
      Went right, up a curving ramp in the cave killing my way through. I'm a hunter (lvl 35) so when I jumped my pet brought spawns by going the long way. [b]DISMISS your pet/minion before jumping down![/b] When you're down there, look out for an Earthcaller/Minion PAT and kill your way to the Khan.
      When you start killing, take down Khan at all costs. Ignore the two guard centaur. After I brought Khan down, I died, but looted just before I did. With the head in my bags, I rezzed at the Graveyard and moved on to Warug. It seemed the most painless way to do it.
      Was harder for me because right before I got to the Khan I ran out of arrows and food and bandages. [b](PS: Be warned, the centaur spawn QUICKLY...get in, get out!)[/b]

I've found Shaka in 2 different spots.  The first time I went through I stuck to the left and found him at the end of that path.  Since I was a dummy and I forgot to loot the head I had to go back in again.  This time as you go in you get to an area on your left with a few mobs and a tent structure. About "concentrating on Shaka", it isn't the best strategy for druids and other self-healing classes out there. It's just the opposite: get rid of any weaker enemy, so you can heal yourself without getting much interference during the casting time.

I started with the lv35 bg. Sneaked behind him, ravage, two claw, switched to NS form to spam moonfire before he could call for help. Heal, cat form, attack the lv36 bg, rinse, repeat. Then, you can focus on Shaka, since you've now mana and some tranquility.

Again, just like the last crystal quest - if you just STOP KILLING them the second you ding friendly, you will still be on good terms with the Gelkis!  You can walk through the cave without being attacked at all.

150/3000 Unfriendly = attackable, but won't aggro to you at all.

Kill the boss, and guess what? 25/3000 - you can still walk out - but you either have to have a break-aggro ability like rogue vanish or hunter feign death, or let yourself die after looting - the guards will still be on you. DO NOT KILL THE GUARDS - or you will have to fight your way out!  Just drop combat or let them kill you. Rez or whatever now that you are not in combat, and walk away.
